articles.title: 🔴Nepal-Tibet floods live: Death toll passes 580, nearly 2,500 people missing
articles.description: Rescue teams have suspended operations on Friday in the heart of the Tibetan disaster zone as authorities confirm that a lake formed by a mudslide on the China-Nepal border has burst, threatening further damage. The devastating flooding in Nepal and Tibet has claimed more than 400 lives and left hundreds missing, with ongoing conditions complicating rescue efforts. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.

articles.title: Nepal flood disaster reconstructed minute by minute
articles.description: New satellite imagery and video analysis show the deadly Nepal floods began when part of a glacier near the Chinese border collapsed, triggering a debris flow that raced downstream at up to 150 km/h and devastated communities over more than 80 kilometres. Scientists are still piecing together the exact sequence of events, while authorities warn the disaster may not be over as a newly formed lake upstream has started to overflow.

articles.title: Nepal floods explained: The chain of events behind the disaster
articles.description: A glacier broke apart. An ice and rock avalanche followed. Then came an earthquake, before a landslide triggered devastating floods that tore through kilometres of valley. This is what happened along the Nepal-China border, where rescue teams are still trying to recover survivors 48 hours after the catastrophe. FRANCE 24 breaks down the chain of events and the scientific explanations behind the disaster.

articles.title: Japan's controversial WWII heroes: How one kamikaze pilot escaped certain death
articles.description: Towards the end of World War II, as US troops advanced across the Pacific, Japan resorted to a desperate strategy: kamikaze attacks. Thousands of Japanese pilots, with an average age of just 21, were ordered to crash their explosive-laden planes into enemy ships. More than 3,800 pilots gave up their lives, killing over 7,000 allied naval personnel. Our reporter Mélodie Sforza met one of the last surviving former kamikaze pilots.

articles.title: Nepal flood survivors rescued from hydropower tunnel

articles.title: Nepal: A newly formed lake is sparking fears of more flooding along the Chinese border
articles.description: Rescue operations are continuing after the devastating Nepal-China floods, but authorities have ordered emergency teams to stay on high alert as a newly formed upstream lake threatens to burst and trigger fresh flooding.
